name: Beauty Blazes Brightest Before It Fades
take: Damage against Deconstructed targets gains 12.5% Crit Rate — and since Ars Gratia Artis smears Deconstruction across her whole kit, that reads as near-permanent free crit. The second clause feeds the engine: Chromatic Splendor on a Dispersed target refunds 30 points of Substance, so her basic skill combo alone walks the Forte bar toward the next Final Bow.

name: Fallen Petals Give Life to New Blooms
take: Fatal Finale's DMG Multiplier is increased by 126%. One line, no conditions. The Tango's closing number graduates from finisher to headline act — and with Final Bow's 80% stacked underneath it, it becomes one of the single biggest buttons she owns.

name: Adelante, Cortado, Spinning in Grace
take: The dancer's node, and pound for pound the best stop on the chain. Two gifts: the Outro gains Kaleidoscope Sparks — an extra 1032.18% strike appended to Closing Remark — and Art of Violence plus Chromatic Splendor gain 93% to their multipliers. That second clause nearly doubles her bread-and-butter skill pressure on every single rotation, not just in burst windows.

name: Yesterday's Raindrops Make Finest Wine
take: Every Heavy in her repertoire — plain, Containment Tactics, Imminent Oblivion — pours a round for the house: all Resonators gain 25% Resonance Skill DMG Bonus for 30s. Her own Tango drinks it too, since the entire Liberation counts as Resonance Skill DMG. A personal chain node that moonlights as a team buff.

name: Toast to Past, Today, and Every Day to Come
take: Imminent Oblivion's DMG Multiplier is increased by 47%. The Tinted Crystal execution was already north of 500% at max rank — this pushes the heaviest swing in her heavy slot into ultimate territory on a 22s timer.

name: As the Curtain Falls, I Remain What I Am
take: Death Knell doubles its crystal shards for a total 186.6% increase to its DMG Multiplier — and every shot now inflicts Scattering, freezing targets in place on hit. The Tango stops being a dance the enemy attends and becomes one they're bolted into. Room locked, curtain down, and she's the only one still moving.
